claims: High Point University (HPU) is a private institution.
High Point University (HPU) is United Methodist-affiliated.
High Point University (HPU) is located in High Point, North Carolina.
High Point University (HPU) is known as "The Premier Life Skills University."
High Point University (HPU) has a 99% job placement rate within six months of graduation.
High Point University (HPU) has been ranked the #1 Best-Run College by The Princeton Review for two consecutive years.
High Point University (HPU) has over 6,300 students.
High Point University (HPU) offers 73 undergraduate majors.
High Point University (HPU) offers 70 minors.
High Point University (HPU) has test-optional admissions.
High Point University (HPU) has a Business school.
High Point University (HPU) has a Pharmacy school.
High Point University (HPU) has a Health Sciences school.
High Point University (HPU) has an Art & Design school.
High Point University (HPU) has a new law school.
The HPU Panthers compete in NCAA Division I.
The HPU Panthers compete in the Big South Conference.
High Point University (HPU) features an "Innovation Corridor".
Over $500 million has been invested in academic facilities at High Point University (HPU).
High Point University (HPU) is under the leadership of Dr. Nido Qubein.
